name: Super Coin Box
description: Grab the coins, stomp or dodge the enemies that pour in faster and faster. Three lives. A Phaser 2 platformer from the Phaser examples gallery.
goal: Super Coin Box. Use the arrow keys: Left and Right to run, Up to jump. Grab the coin; a new one appears somewhere else each time. Enemies keep coming down from the top: landing on one from above kills it, touching it any other way costs a life. You have three lives. Collect as many coins as you can.

score.expression: (() => { const g = (window.Phaser && Phaser.GAMES || []).find(Boolean); if (!g || !g.global) { return { over: false, score: 0 }; } const s = g.state.current; return { over: s === 'gameOver', score: g.global.score, lives: g.global.playerLives, level: g.global.currentLevel, state: s }; })()
score.label: coins
